Senses.Explanation: Literally, “cut the cat.” This graph form occurs 278 times in 119 allowlisted texts and is the orthographic counterpart of “cut the cat” (斬猫), not a different event. In the records it abbreviates the public case in which the east and west halls fight over a cat; Nanquan holds it up and says, “If you can speak, I will not cut it,” the assembly gives no answer, and he cuts the cat in two. When Zhaozhou returns, he puts a sandal on his head and leaves; Nanquan says that had he been there, he would have saved the cat. The phrase functions as case narration and title, an object of questions, a subject for verses, and a cited precedent. One public exchange explicitly asks, “Killing living beings is a major precept; why did Nanquan cut the cat and Guizong cut the snake?”; the master tells the questioner to repent. Another sermon quotes the rule to rescue animals from killing and asks how Nanquan's cat and Guizong's snake could have been saved. These passages establish the corpus's own precept relation without stating Nanquan's intention. Asked for the case's import, Jueyin answers only, “It takes Nanquan” (須是南泉始得). Dahui reports and rejects students' labels “timely wondrous function” and “great function appears, not retaining rules.”
Senses.Note: The two cat graphs (貓/猫) are orthographic variants and receive separate searchable articles with one shared case sense. The entry preserves the explicit precept challenges and refusals without deciding why Nanquan acted.

Occurrences.Kwic: 南泉一日兩堂爭貓，泉提起貓云：「道得即不斬。」眾無對，泉斬貓為兩段。南泉舉問趙州，州脫鞋戴出，泉云：「子在，救得貓兒。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Hongzhi's case collection preserves the full event with the traditional cat graph.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「殺生是大戒，為甚麼南泉斬貓、歸宗斬蛇？」師云：「汝實恁麼問麼？」云：「是。」師云：「汝當懺悔去。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: A public interview explicitly calls killing a major precept and names both cases.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊道：若見世人殺畜生時，應方便救護，解其苦難。祇如南泉斬貓、歸宗斬蛇，當恁麼時，作何方便可以救得？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Guxue Zhe (古雪哲禪師語錄), release-pond address. Guxue Zhe is the exact governing speaker: after quoting Shakyamuni Buddha's injunction to rescue animals, he cites Nanquan Puyuan cutting the cat and Guizong Zhichang cutting the snake, then asks what expedient could have rescued them. Nanquan and Guizong are the named case actors invoked inside Guxue's public question, not substitutes for its speaker.

Roles: cat-case actor cited in the question

Occurrences.Kwic: 初參覺印，問曰：南泉斬貓兒，意旨如何？印曰：須是南泉始得。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷): complete-case exact-turn review identifies Guangfu Weishang as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 大慧云：『歸宗斬蛇，南泉斬貓。學語之流多，謂之當機妙用，亦謂之大用現前，不存軌則。殊不知總不是這般道理。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dahui reports and rejects two stock descriptions of the paired cases.
